title: dom-api-tracer: measure which DOM APIs real test suites use
description: dom-api-tracer plugs into Vitest or Jest, instruments the DOM implementation the tests run on (jsdom or happy-dom), and records every DOM method call, property read and property write per test file, which a CLI aggregates into a usage report across files and projects. It also contains the research harness used to evaluate warpdom: a pinned corpus of open-source projects, scripts that run each project's own test suite traced and untraced under different DOM environments, and the timing, correctness and profiling workflows.
